book: Magic Tree House #2: The Knight at Dawn

questions.text: What time was it when Jack looked at the clock?
Why was Jack looking at his notebook?
options: He was studying for a test.
He was trying to understand yesterday's strange events.

questions.text: What did Annie want to find out at the tree house?
options: Whether the magic person was real

questions.text: What did Annie shine her flashlight on near the end?
What did Jack write in his notebook about the gold object?
questions.sample: He wrote about the gold medallion and added the letter M.

questions.text: Where did Jack and Annie go early in the morning?
questions.sample: They went to the Frog Creek woods and the tree house.

questions.text: What happened after Annie began climbing?
questions.sample: Annie disappeared into the tree house, leaving Jack alone in the dark.

questions.text: Why did Jack tell Annie to be quiet as they left the house? Use evidence from the chapter.
questions.sample: He did not want their parents to wake up or anyone to see them sneaking out.

questions.text: How are Jack and Annie different in their reactions to the mysterious tree house? Give one example of each.
questions.sample: Jack is cautious and worried that the magic person might be mean; Annie is curious and eager to go back and investigate.

vocabulary.example: Jack tried to figure out what had happened.
Jack wrote about the gold medallion.
The mysterious tree house was high in the tree.
Annie saw a long rope ladder.

writingPrompt: Write 5–7 English sentences about what Jack and Annie discovered and what you think might happen next. Use two details from Chapter 1.
speakingPrompt:
1. Why couldn't Jack sleep?
2. What did Annie want to find out?
3. What do you predict will happen after Annie climbs the rope ladder?
